instruction.text: Drag the turtle to the ocean.

feedback.finish: The Maya believed that the world was shaped like a giant turtle that floated on the ocean.

instruction.text: Select the sky to find out about the heavens.

feedback.finish: In the sky, there were the heavens. The heavens had thirteen levels, and only the people who were sacrificed or who died in battle went to the highest level.

instruction.sound: ssml: Spell the name <phoneme alphabet='ipa' ph='ʃiɓalˈɓa'>Xibalba</phoneme>.

atoms.word: X i b a l b a

text: The Maya believed in a dark underworld called Xibalba, which was ruled over by the gods of death, such as Ah Puch. This was where people who died of natural causes went in the afterlife.
finish.sound: ssml: The Maya believed in a dark underworld called <phoneme alphabet='ipa' ph='ʃiɓalˈɓa'>Xibalba</phoneme>, which was ruled over by the gods of death, such as Ah Pukk. This was where people who died of natural causes went in the afterlife.

finish.text: The Maya thought that the entrance to Xibalba was in underground caves filled with water called cenotes. These cenotes can still be found across Central America and they are sacred to the Maya.
finish.sound: ssml: The Maya thought that the entrance to <phoneme alphabet='ipa' ph='ʃiɓalˈɓa'>Xibalba</phoneme> was in underground caves filled with water called senottase. These senottase can still be found across Central America and they are sacred to the Maya.

instruction.text: Read the cause of death and decide whether the person went to Xibalba or the heavens.
